name: HL7 v2 to FHIR
what_it_is: An HL7 STU 1 Implementation Guide defining declarative ConceptMap mappings for converting HL7 v2.x messages, segments, datatypes, and vocabulary codes to FHIR R4 Bundles. Authored as FHIR Shorthand with a Maven/SUSHI build.
components: Message maps (15 v2 message structures to FHIR Bundles)
Segment maps (~35 v2 segments to FHIR resources)
Datatype maps (~40 v2 datatypes to FHIR types)
constraints: FHIR R4 only; no R5 targets
Temporal fields require platform-specific ISO 8601 reformatting
Declarative only; no runtime engine included
notable_absences: No reference implementation or test harness
